requirement.title: Homepage Footer Newsletter Subscription
requirement.description: As a site visitor, I want to subscribe to the newsletter by submitting my email address in the homepage footer subscription box so that I receive promotional updates and discounts.
acceptanceCriteria:
<untrusted_content source="acceptance_criterion_0">
Footer section displays "SUBSCRIPTION" heading and email input with placeholder "Your email address".
</untrusted_content>

<untrusted_content source="acceptance_criterion_1">
Submitting a valid unique email displays success message "You have been successfully subscribed!".
</untrusted_content>

<untrusted_content source="acceptance_criterion_2">
Submitting an empty or malformed email prevents successful subscription and triggers validation feedback.
</untrusted_content>
constraints: Must function without prior user login/authentication.
Must not cause full page reload or navigate away from homepage.

scenarios.title: Homepage Footer Newsletter Subscription - Successful submission with valid inputs
scenarios.objective: Verify that submitting valid inputs satisfies acceptance criteria, displays success confirmation, and retains the user on the homepage.
preconditions: System Under Test (SUT) is accessible at base URL.
Target feature interface or component is visibly rendered.
testSteps: Navigate to target page containing the Homepage Footer Newsletter Subscription interface.
Locate input controls and enter valid, dynamically generated test data.
Click submit button to trigger form processing.
expectedResults: Newsletter subscription form submits successfully with unique dynamic email.
Visual confirmation alert is visibly displayed with text 'You have been successfully subscribed!'.
User remains on the homepage without unintended navigation or URL redirection.
Global navigation controls remain visible and accessible.
assumptions: Target element locators conform to AutomationExercise DOM structure.

scenarios.title: Homepage Footer Newsletter Subscription - Input validation error with malformed data
scenarios.objective: Verify that submitting malformed or syntactically invalid input is rejected via HTML5 email validation without submitting the form.
preconditions: SUT is accessible at base URL.
Target input field is in initial unmodified state.
testSteps: Enter malformed input (e.g. invalid email format without '@' or domain).
expectedResults: Email input element enforces HTML5 type='email' attribute specification.
Submitting malformed email triggers browser validity mismatch (validity.typeMismatch is true, checkValidity() is false).
Browser validation message is non-empty, preventing form dispatch.
Success confirmation alert is not visible.
User remains on the homepage without unintended redirection.
assumptions: Browser HTML5 validation flags invalid formats prior to network dispatch.
ambiguityNotes: Exact validation error text may vary between Chromium HTML5 popover and custom application DOM.

scenarios.title: Homepage Footer Newsletter Subscription - Boundary check with empty input submission
scenarios.objective: Verify that attempting submission with empty required input fields triggers HTML5 required-field validation and blocks submission.
preconditions: Target form is open and input fields are empty.
testSteps: Leave required input field completely blank.
expectedResults: Email input element enforces HTML5 'required' attribute specification.
Attempting submission with empty input triggers valueMissing validity error (validity.valueMissing is true, checkValidity() is false).
Browser validation message is non-empty, preventing empty form dispatch.
Success confirmation alert is not visible.
User remains on the homepage without unintended redirection.

missingOrAmbiguousRequirements: Check whether rate-limiting applies to repeated submissions from the same IP/session.
designTechniquesApplied: Equivalence Partitioning (Valid vs Malformed input classes)
